freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the pi adapter's output over the conformance scenario at harness 0.74.0 (in-band storage-FORMAT int session.version = 3, same as 0.58.1 and 0.80.3; the harness RELEASE version 0.74.0 is capture provenance, not in-band). pi is preprocessor-less: the DSL runner reads the native JSONL directly. verify.py re-runs the DSL on each input (cwd = this dir), normalizes the volatile provenance.converted_at, and asserts trace_count, the canonical (RFC 8785 JCS) content_hash, and unmapped_path_count. pi traces carry no provenance.source_path, so the freeze is checkout-independent. annotated_cells_fired is the structural fired-cell set (equals the pi CELL_SIGNALS extractor exactly). Older end of pi's IMAGE release delta 0.74.0 -> 0.80.3 (both version-pinned container captures). 0.74.0 is the OLDEST pi version published on npm — pi 0.58.1 is unpublished and cannot be image-captured, so it remains only as an archived-corpus rung.
